title: Severally
summary: SEV'ERALLY, adverb Separately; distinctly; apart from others. Call the men severally by name. I could not keep my eye steady on them severally so as to number them. Newton. To be jointly and severally

inlines.v: SEV'ERALLY, adverb Separately; distinctly; apart from others. Call the men severally by name. I could not keep my eye steady on them severally so as to number them. Newton. To be jointly and severally bound in a contract, is for each obligor to be liable to pay the whole demand, in case the other or others are not able.
